dedupe_keys.name: metaheuristics and learned initialization for multidimensional heterogeneous vehicle routing with mixed pickup and delivery on directed road networks

description: Yelda Fırat publishes a vehicle-routing application and reproducibility package for heterogeneous fleets on directed road networks. Zenodo lists public application and source-data archives plus a separate README under CC BY 4.0. The README distinguishes canonical analytical data and frozen configurations from the original workbook, and identifies 48 validation batches with 771 requests across seven assumed service scenarios. It reports feasible, impossible and unresolved cells, explicitly warning that a failed search is not proof of infeasibility. The package can test pickup-and-delivery routing or service-time assumptions in logistics simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this study package. Coverage is the published instance and fleet scenarios, not measured driver schedules; its 96-hour route horizon is not a validated continuous shift. A limitation is that exact training and timed optimisation experiments are not rerun by the archived verification checks. Neither archive was downloaded or executed, and no route feasibility certificate was independently checked.
